function testArraysAndExceptions() { let numbers = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]; let first = numbers[0]; let second = numbers[1]; console.log(("First item: " + first)); try { if ((first > 100)) { throw "Number exceeds maximum allowed limit"; } console.log("Validation passed successfully"); } catch (err) { console.error(("Encountered exception: " + err)); } finally { console.log("Cleanup completed"); } for (let n of numbers) { console.log(("Number: " + n)); } }
